findings.text: §21's first reader is mislocated: the `_persisted_worker_environment` call in `reckon/crew/dispatch.py` (now `:3351`, the "near line 3282" §21 names) sits inside the `else` branch of `dispatch()` that is commented "An in-harness launch composes no plan here" and sets `plan = None`, so no backend is composed, no backend command is launched, and `record["directive"]["environment"]` is the only environment that branch persists; a backend launch's persisted PATH is composed in the `if` branch's supervisor spec through the same `_persisted_worker_environment` -> `launch_search_path` chain (`reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2357`), so the persisted PATH and the supervisor launch PATH read from one function and cannot disagree — the premise "one dispatch's two records disagree" has no mechanism behind it.

findings.reason: as written the case either cannot be constructed or passes on the unfixed code, so the section's only measure for its first deliverable is unmeasurable.
findings.text: the first case asserts that "a dispatch's persisted directive environment and its supervisor launch environment carry the same PATH entry", but on the in-harness branch §21 targets there is no supervisor launch environment to compare against, and on a cli launch both sides come from the single `_persisted_worker_environment` composer, so an equality-only assertion holds with or without the fix; the case needs to name a cli launch and assert the declared directory is present in the persisted PATH (and separately in the launched environment), which is what its negative control assumes.
